notes: One unadjusted NQ contract per session. New York overnight hours are 18:00–09:30 and regular hours are 09:30–16:00.
The study covers January 2015 through September 18, 2026. 2018–2019 supply 295 of 307 earlier-era sessions.
Reel benchmark: Instagram reel Dfai3hHvMDn by @rithvikrishna64. Its exact sample and event definitions are unavailable.
Reaches use one-minute OHLC. The study describes price behavior and does not estimate trade execution or returns.

sections.alt: Overnight boundary reach rates by opening half, with Wilson intervals and reel benchmarks.
sections.caption: Overnight boundary reach rates by opening half, with Wilson intervals and reel benchmarks.
sections.description: A level is reached when a regular-hour minute trades at or beyond it. Each group contains sessions strictly inside the overnight range, with midpoint ties shown separately.
sections.finding: NQ reached the overnight high on 80.4% of upper-half opens (830/1032) and the overnight low on 76.1% of lower-half opens (600/788). The reel reported 80.8% and 75.7%, respectively. Its sample and exact event definitions are unknown.
sections.title: How often does NQ reach the overnight high or low?

sections.alt: Near-only, far-only, both and neither outcomes across overnight width bands.
sections.caption: Near-only, far-only, both and neither outcomes across overnight width bands.
sections.description: Show mutually exclusive near-only, far-only, both and neither outcomes by width. Equal-distance opens are separated from the near-versus-far view.
sections.finding: Both boundaries were reached on 32.6% of narrow sessions and 17.4% of wide sessions. The chart keeps both-side movement and directional-only movement separate.
sections.title: Do narrow ranges make both sides easier to reach?

sections.alt: Near-first and both-side reach rates by overnight width and VXN, with session counts.
sections.caption: Near-first and both-side reach rates by overnight width and VXN, with session counts.
sections.description: Separate near-first from both-side reaches. Near-first chart rates keep same-minute cases in the full denominator as unresolved rather than awarding either side. Sparse cells show counts.
sections.finding: Narrow/high VXN had 42.4% both-side reaches (n=66). Wide/low VXN had 12.2% both-side reaches (n=123). The two panels distinguish which side was first from whether both sides were eventually reached.
sections.title: What happens when range width and volatility disagree?
